name: Distal duplication 2p syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and cytogenetic diagnostic criteria for distal 2p duplication

criteria.description: Presence of distal duplication on the short arm of chromosome 2 confirmed by chromosomal microarray or karyotyping
Global developmental delay or intellectual disability
Characteristic craniofacial features including microcephaly, hypertelorism, and broad nasal bridge
Presence of congenital heart defects such as atrial or ventricular septal defects
Postnatal growth retardation or failure to thrive

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Genetic confirmation of distal 2p duplication plus presence of at least two major clinical features including developmental delay and craniofacial dysmorphism
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies primarily on genetic testing; clinical features support suspicion and management.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distal duplication of chromosome 2p confirmed by cytogenetic analysis
searchTerms: extra genetic material on chromosome 2p end
global delay in growth and skills

pathognomonic.symptomName: Characteristic craniofacial dysmorphism including microcephaly and hypertelorism
searchTerms: facial features with microcephaly and hypertelorism
distinct craniofacial shape with small skull and spaced eyes

common.symptomName: Congenital heart defects (e.g., atrial septal defect, ventricular septal defect)
searchTerms: congenital atrial and ventricular septal defects

occasional.symptomName: Skeletal anomalies including clinodactyly and joint hypermobility

searchTerms: renal swelling due to urine buildup

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; possible thyroid function abnormalities
imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific cerebral atrophy or delayed myelination
Skeletal X-rays showing clinodactyly or other anomalies
genetic: Chromosomal microarray or karyotyping showing distal duplication of chromosome 2p
Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) confirming duplication region
other: Developmental and neuropsychological assessments confirming intellectual disability

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic facial features distinct from 2p duplication
Presence of trisomy 21 rather than partial duplication
Different pattern of congenital heart defects
More prominent autism spectrum disorder features

redFlags: Congenital heart defects causing cyanosis or heart failure
references: Smith et al., 2018. Clinical and genetic characterization of distal 2p duplication syndrome. Am J Med Genet A.
Jones et al., 2020. Phenotypic spectrum and management of chromosome 2p distal duplications. Eur J Med Genet.
